ceu: ✦ The opposition between Mars and Neptune

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
Until {H:1816597675000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.
The opposition between Mars and Neptune creates some tension between relationships and your image. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Value your time: do not work for free for people who can pay.

t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.
Until {H:1816597675000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up rest and your inner life.
The opposition between Mars and Neptune creates some tension between routine and your inner life. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Move your body first thing in the morning, even if it is only a ten-minute walk.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.
Until {H:1816597675000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.
The opposition between Mars and Neptune creates some tension between romance and friendships. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Help someone quietly, without them knowing it was you.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
Until {H:1816597675000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up your career and your goals.
The opposition between Mars and Neptune creates some tension between family and your career. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Share a project of yours with someone who can help.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.
Until {H:1816597675000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.
The opposition between Mars and Neptune creates some tension between conversations and your horizons. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Ask for an honest opinion from someone you respect.

t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.
Until {H:1816597675000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.
The opposition between Mars and Neptune creates some tension between money and intimacy. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Write down where you want to be a year from now.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.
Until {H:1816597675000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.
The opposition between Mars and Neptune creates some tension between your image and relationships. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: End the day with a minute of gratitude for what has changed in you.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
Until {H:1816597675000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.
The opposition between Mars and Neptune creates some tension between your inner life and routine. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to your partner or to a close friend.

t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
Until {H:1816597675000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.
The opposition between Mars and Neptune creates some tension between friendships and romance. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Swap a snack for fruit and notice how you feel.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.
Until {H:1816597675000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up home and family.
The opposition between Mars and Neptune creates some tension between your career and family. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Dance at home, even if it is just to one song.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.
Until {H:1816597675000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.
The opposition between Mars and Neptune creates some tension between your horizons and conversations. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Open the windows in the morning and let fresh air into your home.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.
Until {H:1816597675000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up your money and what you value.
The opposition between Mars and Neptune creates some tension between intimacy and money. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Before reacting to a message, read it twice.
